title: AMD expected to launch next generation of AI infrastructure to challenge Nvidia
byline: By Max A. Cherney and Stephen Nellis
excerpt: SAN FRANCISCO, July 23 (Reuters) - Advanced Micro Devices is set to launch a raft of AI hardware that ‌will rival Nvidia on Thursday at an event at a downtow...
content_html:
By Max A. Cherney and Stephen Nellis

SAN FRANCISCO, July 23 (Reuters) - Advanced Micro Devices is set to launch a raft of AI hardware that ‌will rival Nvidia on Thursday at an event at a downtown convention ‌center in San Francisco.

AMD is attempting to capture market share from Nvidia in the fast-growing data center ​chip sector, especially for so-called inference computing, which is the data crunching that occurs when a user queries a chatbot such as OpenAI's ChatGPT.

AMD is expected to show off the company's data center hardware that includes its first-generation server racks called Helios, which ‌it is marketing as a ⁠rival to a similar design from Nvidia, which is rolling out its second-generation product this year.

The company also is expected to ⁠formally launch its Venice central processing unit (CPU) for data centers.

This week, Nvidia released a spate of technical details about its Vera CPU, which aimed to show that the chip, when ​combined ​with Nvidia's "Rubin" graphics processing unit (GPU), will do the ​best job at maximizing how ‌much work AI agents can do with a given amount of electricity.

At the Moscone West convention center on Wednesday, hundreds of executives and engineers gathered to take in technical presentations and mingle on a showroom floor, according to a Reuters witness.

AMD displayed the Helios data center rack amid booths from cloud computing providers such as Vultr ‌and TensorWave. Both cloud providers operate data centers ​with AMD hardware.

On Wednesday, AMD announced plans to ​sell up to two gigawatts of ​its Instinct MI450 chips to AI lab Anthropic beginning in ‌the first half of 2027. The deal ​also includes an investment ​of as much as $5 billion in the Claude maker.

In October, AMD announced a multiyear deal with OpenAI that would also bring in tens of billions ​of dollars in annual ‌revenue while giving the ChatGPT creator the option to buy up to ​roughly 10% of the chipmaker.

(Reporting by Max A. Cherney and Stephen Nellis ​in San Francisco; Editing by Matthew Lewis)

content_html_zh:
作者：马克斯·A. 切尔尼和斯蒂芬·内利斯

路透旧金山 7 月 23 日 - Advanced Micro Devices 将于周四在旧金山市中心会议中心举行的一次活动中推出一系列人工智能硬件，与 Nvidia 展开竞争。

AMD 正试图在快速增长的数据中心芯片领域从 Nvidia 手中夺取市场份额，尤其是所谓的推理计算，即用户查询 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 等聊天机器人时发生的数据处理。

AMD 预计将展示该公司的数据中心硬件，其中包括名为 Helios 的第一代服务器机架，AMD 将其作为 Nvidia 类似设计的竞争对手进行营销，Nvidia 今年将推出第二代产品。

该公司预计还将正式推出用于数据中心的 Venice 中央处理器 (CPU)。

本周，Nvidia 发布了一系列有关其 Vera CPU 的技术细节，旨在表明该芯片与 Nvidia 的“Rubin”图形处理单元 (GPU) 结合使用时，将在最大化 AI 代理在给定电量的情况下完成多少工作方面发挥最佳作用。

据路透社目击者称，周三，在莫斯康西会议中心，数百名高管和工程师聚集在一起，听取技术演示，并在展厅里交流。

AMD 在 Vultr 和 TensorWave 等云计算提供商的展位上展示了 Helios 数据中心机架。 两家云提供商都使用 AMD 硬件运营数据中心。

周三，AMD 宣布计划从 2027 年上半年开始向 AI 实验室 Anthropic 出售高达 2GW 的 Instinct MI450 芯片。 该交易还包括对克劳德制造商高达 50 亿美元的投资。

10 月，AMD 宣布与 OpenAI 达成一项多年期协议，该协议还将带来数百亿美元的年收入，同时让 ChatGPT 的创建者可以选择购买该芯片制造商最多约 10% 的股份。

（Max A. 的报道 切尔尼和斯蒂芬·内利斯在旧金山；马修·刘易斯编辑）
